name: forge-eval
description: Evaluate the code-generation capabilities of coding agents on existing codebases.

interface.shortDescription: Evaluate code generation on existing codebases
interface.longDescription: ForgeEval evaluates the code-generation capabilities of coding agents on existing codebases. It provides a defined project baseline and change requirements, then assesses the generated code through independent acceptance checks. Each run preserves the inputs, generated code, logs, and results for inspection. ForgeEval works as a standalone Python CLI and as a shared plugin for Claude Code and Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use ForgeEval to evaluate this project change.
